purpose: Persistent failure codes so repeated defects are tracked across runs instead of re-diagnosed each time.

F01_IDENTITY_COLLISION.label: Identity collision
F01_IDENTITY_COLLISION.definition: Two distinct subjects converge toward one person, or generated faces are near-duplicates.

F02_WARDROBE_LEAKAGE.label: Wardrobe leakage
F02_WARDROBE_LEAKAGE.definition: Clothing, footwear or styling from the avatar calibration photographs is copied into the output instead of current PINK MALL fashion direction.
F02_WARDROBE_LEAKAGE.gate: wardrobeSourceValid must be true for fashion-led campaigns

F03_BRAND_HERITAGE_DRIFT.label: Brand heritage drift
F03_BRAND_HERITAGE_DRIFT.definition: Output loses the Pierciina retro/disco lineage and becomes a generic glossy pink luxury mall or anonymous AI-fashion aesthetic.

F04_PRODUCT_GEOMETRY_DRIFT.label: Product geometry drift
F04_PRODUCT_GEOMETRY_DRIFT.definition: Product shape, logo, hardware or proportions deviate from the authoritative catalogue image, or an avatar wear-reference was treated as product geometry.

F05_COMPOSITION_FAILURE.label: Composition failure
F05_COMPOSITION_FAILURE.definition: Banner geometry unusable — text-safe region violated, wrong aspect ratio, subject crosses a reserved band, face lost in a required crop.

F06_SUBJECT_ROLE_SWAP.label: Subject role swap
F06_SUBJECT_ROLE_SWAP.definition: INA appears in SIS's designated zone or creative register, or vice versa.

F07_REFERENCE_OVERFIT.label: Reference overfit
F07_REFERENCE_OVERFIT.definition: Output reproduces a specific reference frame — its background, pose or framing — instead of using it as evidence. The domestic terrace appearing in a campaign is the signature.

F08_GENERIC_FASHION_DRIFT.label: Generic fashion drift
F08_GENERIC_FASHION_DRIFT.definition: Output reads as anonymous stock fashion — no PINK MALL character, no Pierciina lineage, interchangeable with any brand.

observed: Both generated women converged toward INA; SIS was not preserved as a distinct second person.
Generator copied the clothing language of the calibration photographs instead of current PINK MALL fashion direction.
Output became a generic glossy pink luxury mall with no retro Pierciina lineage.
runLog.diagnosis: Three independent pipeline defects, not evidence against the identity pools. F01 points to undifferentiated reference grouping in the handoff. F02 points to a missing wardrobe authority layer - the only clothing the model could see was calibration clothing. F03 points to a brand layer that described PINK MALL generically without the Pierciina heritage anchors.
runLog.actionTaken: v1.3 hardening patch: collision protocol, wardrobe authority separation, heritage DNA layer, revised assembly order, failure taxonomy, new hard gates.

doctrine: A failed generation is evidence about the pipeline. It is never permission to rewrite the identity system.
